Closes #4832

S+ #102 Cosmic Bard's Radiant face set each drawn Unit's price with a lone cost override of `cheapest − cost_mod`, but an override clamps at 0, so a Unit carrying a raise larger than the cheapest price kept its excess (a (0) Unit with +2 priced at 2 instead of 1 when the cheapest drawn was 1).

````text
# #4832: Patch: Radiant Cosmic Bard leaves both drawn Units at the cheapest price, even one that carries a cost raise larger than that price
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

S+ #102 Cosmic Bard's Radiant face ("Combo: Draw 2 Units and set both their costs to the cheapest drawn") sets each drawn Unit's price with a cost override, taking the card's own cost change off so the two add back up to the cheapest price:

```rust
// crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c102_cosmic_bard.rs:60
"cost": (cheapest - card.cost_mod).max(0),
```

An override cannot go below 0 (`set_cost_override` clamps as well, `crates/engine/src/effects/cost.rs:123`). So when a drawn Unit carries a raise larger than the cheapest price, the override bottoms out at 0 and the raise still adds: the card ends dearer than the cheapest drawn.

Concrete: the two topmost Units of the deck are a (0) Unit carrying `costMod` +2 (price 2) and a plain (1) Unit. The cheapest drawn is 1. The (1) Unit costs 1. The other gets override `max(0, 1 − 2) = 0`, its +2 still adds, and it costs **2**.

A legal path: S #12.3 Psychic Scream's Radiant face ("Shuffle all permanents into your opponent's deck. Each costs (2) more (up to (4))") puts raised Units into the opponent's deck (R78: a cost change persists in every zone). The second test plays exactly that.

### What should happen

Both cost 1. R3568001: the Radiant face "takes the least, and sets every drawn Unit that is in the hand to it with a `costOverride`; a cost change a card carries is taken off the override, so each card ends at that one price." §8.12 row 102: "to the least price they had in the deck, a carried cost change taken off." The script's own comment at that line states the intent: "to leave each card at the cheapest price".

### How to reproduce

Two tests fail on `main` (3a83bd7), in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_splus_b.rs` at 89644cb](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/89644cb/crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_splus_b.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`; the file sits in the AI crate's tests only because that target links the testkit and every card): by direct setup, and by play alone.

```rust
use jackioh_engine::testkit::PlayerId::P1;
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;
const BARD: &str = "stinkyscapeplus-102";
const FILLER: &str = "core-005";
const FREE_SPELL: &str = "stand-in (0) Spell";
const FREE_UNIT: &str = "stand-in (0) 1/1";
const ONE_UNIT: &str = "stand-in (1) 1/1";

fn price_in_hand(s: &Scenario, def: &str) -> i32 {
    let card = s.hand(P1).into_iter().find(|card| card.def_id == def)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{def} is not in p1's hand"));
    effective_cost(s.state(), &card, Default::default())
}

#[test]
fn r3568001_radiant_cosmic_bard_sets_every_drawn_unit_to_the_cheapest_price() {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    let mut s = scenario(json!({
        "p1": { "mana": 10, "hand": [FREE_SPELL, { "def": BARD, "radiant": true }],
                "library": [{ "def": FREE_UNIT, "costMod": 2 }, ONE_UNIT, FILLER, FILLER] },
        "p2": { "library": [FILLER, FILLER, FILLER, FILLER] },
    }));
    s.play(FREE_SPELL, json!({}));   // the Combo's earlier play
    s.play(BARD, json!({ "zone": 1 }));
    assert_eq!(price_in_hand(&s, ONE_UNIT), 1, "the cheapest drawn stays at its price");
    assert_eq!(price_in_hand(&s, FREE_UNIT), 1,
        "R3568001: each drawn Unit ends at the cheapest drawn price, the raise it carried taken off");
}
```

Output today: `R3568001: each drawn Unit ends at the cheapest drawn price, the raise it carried taken off   left: 2   right: 1` (the same from the Psychic Scream path, on its seed 0).

### Where

A card: `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c102_cosmic_bard.rs`.

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- When a drawn card's `cost_mod` is above `cheapest`, also take the excess off its cost change (a cost change of `cheapest − cost_mod`, in hand only) and set the override to 0. Or add an engine verb that sets a hand card's price exactly, in `crates/engine/src/effects/cost.rs` with its test, if other cards would use it (CLAUDE.md, Architecture: a missing verb goes into the engine). An override alone can never get there.
- Only `cost_mod > cheapest` breaks: a negative change, or a raise no larger than the cheapest price, already comes out right. Keep those as they are.
- The cost-change event for these cards is redacted for the opponent (`view_for.rs`, `CostChanged`); a new effect on a hand card must stay so.
- The card's tests go in its own file (CLAUDE.md rule 6): the raised card by direct setup, as above.
- A card change in play: read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first; it needs its pending patch fragment.

Found by an audit of the Stinkyscape+ card scripts against their printed text; the reproductions were run and the script read before filing.

## Goal

Fix S+ #102 Cosmic Bard's Radiant face so every drawn Unit still in the hand ends at the cheapest drawn price even when a drawn Unit carries a `costMod` raise larger than that price. The fix stays in the card script: when `cost_mod > cheapest`, set the override to 0 and take the excess off with a hand-only `setCostMod` of `cheapest − costMod`; all other cases keep the current override-only math. One new behavior test pins the bug case, and the change ships with a pending patch fragment and a kept script.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c102_cosmic_bard.rs` | change | Cry hook: per-card override/mod branch; `pub fn script_kept_4832` (today's behavior); two new tests in `mod tests` |
| `crates/cards/src/history.rs` | change | Add `c102_cosmic_bard` to the `stinkyscape_plus` import block; append one `KEPT_SCRIPTS` row keyed `"fragment:<stem>"` |
| `crates/cards/patches/pending/<slug>.json` | new | Created by `cargo jackioh patches … --plays stinkyscapeplus-102`; hand-written `player` note added after |
| Must not touch | — | `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `crates/engine/` (no verb change); `apps/web/`; `spec/` (no new ruling: R3568001 already states this behavior and its `proven_in` already lists the card file) |

Governing spec: §8.12 row 102, §6.2 Combo, §6.3 Cost, §2.4 draw, R65, R66, R78, R129, R135, R801, R3568001, R4779000 (fragment-keyed kept script).

## Steps

1. In `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c102_cosmic_bard.rs`, read the cry hook (`fn bard`, lines 42–66) and `crates/engine/src/effects/cost.rs` (`set_cost_override` clamps at 0, line 175; `set_cost_mod` adds to `cost_mod`; both honor `inHandOnly` and emit `CostChanged`). Also read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §3 (CLAUDE.md rule 10) before touching the card.
2. Replace the `effects.extend(drawn.iter().map(... set_cost_override((cheapest - card.cost_mod).max(0), inHandOnly) ...))` block with a per-card `flat_map` over the same pre-draw `drawn` snapshot (keep reading `card.cost_mod` from that snapshot, never from live state after the draws). Per card, in drawn order, using the same `{"target": {"of": "instance", "instanceId": card.id}, "inHandOnly": true}` shape: if `card.cost_mod > cheapest`, push `set_cost_override` with `"cost": 0` then `set_cost_mod` with `"amount": cheapest - card.cost_mod`; otherwise push only `set_cost_override` with `"cost": cheapest - card.cost_mod` (today's formula, unchanged). Update the R65 comment above it to state that a raise larger than the cheapest is taken off the change with the override at 0. Decision: card-script fix only; the engine-verb alternative is rejected (one caller, smallest change).
3. Add `pub fn script_kept_4832() -> CardScripts` to the same card file, building base and radiant exactly as today's `bard(false)` / `bard(true)` do (copy the current override-only mapping). Keep `pub fn script()` on the fixed logic. Follow the `script_v0_5_2` precedent (e.g. `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c102_catboy_maid_ssr.rs:70`).
4. Add test `r3568001_radiant_sets_a_drawn_unit_carrying_a_larger_raise_to_the_cheapest` in the file's `mod tests`, reusing its `scenario`, `PlayerId::P1` and stand-in style: `crate::register_all();`, p1 mana 10, hand `[stand-in (0) Spell, { bard, radiant: true }]`, library `[{ FREE_UNIT (stand-in (0) 1/1), "costMod": 2 }, ONE_UNIT (stand-in (1) 1/1), FILLER, FILLER]` (testkit seeds `costMod` per `crates/engine/src/testkit/scenario.rs:888`). Play the spell, then the Bard; assert both hand prices are 1, and pin the fields: raised card `cost_override == Some(0)`, `cost_mod == cheapest - 2`.
5. Add a kept-script test in the same `mod tests` mirroring the new test's setup and plays inside `crate::under_kept(ID, super::super::script_kept_4832(), || { … })` (see `crates/cards/src/lib.rs:311` and the `under_kept` use at `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c102_catboy_maid_ssr.rs:350`), asserting the raised card still costs 2 under the old script.
6. Run `cargo jackioh patches "<title>" --source "#4832" --notes "<what changed>" --plays stinkyscapeplus-102` (script changed how the card plays; no catalog change, so `--plays`, no `--rule`/`--visual`), then hand-write the `player` note in the new fragment JSON: one line under `fixes` per `docs/issues-and-patches.md` (R724001; the command does not write it).
7. In `crates/cards/src/history.rs`, add `c102_cosmic_bard` to the `use crate::scripts::stinkyscape_plus::{…}` block and append `(c102_cosmic_bard::ID, "fragment:<stem>", c102_cosmic_bard::script_kept_4832)` at the end of `KEPT_SCRIPTS`, with `<stem>` exactly the new pending fragment's file stem (R4779000).

- Same file, kept-script test (name it `kept_script_before_4832_still_prices_the_raised_unit_at_2`): same position under `under_kept` with `script_kept_4832`, asserts the raised card costs 2 (pins the kept script to the replaced behavior).
- Existing tests in the file (`r3568001_a_cost_change_a_card_carries_is_taken_off_so_both_cost_the_cheapest` with raise equal to cheapest, X-cost, hand-cap, no-Combo) must stay green unchanged.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c102_cosmic_bard`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo jackioh patches check`; `cargo jackioh catalog check`; `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] `cost_mod > cheapest` drawn Unit ends at the cheapest price (override 0 plus hand-only mod); negative, zero, and smaller raises behave exactly as today.
- [ ] New behavior test and kept-script test pass; every existing `c102_cosmic_bard` test passes unmodified.
- [ ] Pending fragment exists with `--plays stinkyscapeplus-102` and a hand-written `player` note; `KEPT_SCRIPTS` row uses the fragment's stem.
- [ ] The six checks under Tests all pass.

## Risks

- Two `CostChanged` events per raised card (override then mod) instead of one; both ride the existing hand-zone `emit_cost` path, so opponent redaction (`crates/engine/src/view_for.rs:2482`, hidden hand card) is unchanged, and deterministic drawn-order emission keeps replays stable.
- A drawn Unit the hand cap burns: both new effects are `inHandOnly` and fizzle exactly like today's override, per R3568001.
- Purity (CLAUDE.md rule 4): the card file composes existing `set_cost_override` / `set_cost_mod` verbs only; `crates/engine` is untouched.

## Open questions

None.
